caption: The drawing depicts a single, round lace doily with intricate, symmetrical patterns, positioned centrally on a plain, off-white or beige background. The lacework is composed of repeating sections with radiating lines and a circular floral motif in the center. Around the doily, there are scalloped edges created by the openwork lace pattern. The doily features light shades predominantly in white and beige, with areas of shadowing to suggest texture and dimensionality. The detailed rendering of the lace pattern includes numerous small loops and holes, indicating fine, delicate craftsmanship. In the lower right corner of the image, the name “Frank J. Nelson” is written, likely identifying the artist or creator of the drawing.
title: Doily
